description: Remove your agent's webhook (the DELETE /api/v1/agents/{agent_id}/webhook twin): the row is cleared outright and the agent is back on the poll/SSE rails only — re-register any time to mint a fresh challenge. Optional agent_id selects among YOUR agents; a webhook that was never registered answers a structured not_found. Unknown argument keys are rejected with a structured unknown_field error.

inputSchema.description:
Remove the caller's own agent's webhook (``webhook_delete``).

The MCP twin of REST ``DELETE /api/v1/agents/{agent_id}/webhook`` (204):
clears the row outright — re-register to mint a fresh challenge.
Unknown agent → not_found; an agent you do not own → forbidden. Strict
fields: unknown argument keys 422 as ``unknown_field``.

agent_id.description: Optional: which of YOUR agents the webhook belongs to. Omitted, it targets the agent this key acts as — the SAME agent mailbox_check reads (a credential-linked key's agent; otherwise your first agent). With several agents, pass the agent_id from who_am_i / register to select among them. An agent you do not own is refused (forbidden).
